offering_description.value: Sabre runs a global booking marketplace that connects airlines, hotels and car rental companies with travel agencies and online booking sites. It also provides software that helps airlines manage reservations, passenger processing, pricing and sales. Sabre delivers these tools through hosted systems and APIs and offers payment tools for travel companies.

primary_products.value: Travel booking platforms; airline passenger service systems; airline retailing and order management software; airline pricing and revenue management software; travel payment software

primary_services.value: Travel distribution and booking; software implementation and integration; technology consulting; travel payment orchestration

customer_segment.value: B2B: Airlines, retail and online travel agencies, travel management companies, lodging providers and car rental companies

end_markets.value: Commercial aviation; leisure travel; corporate travel; lodging; car rental

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Travel bookings, airline passengers processed and payment transactions; subscription: Recurring access to hosted airline and travel agency software; service fees: Software implementation, integration and consulting
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; subscription; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Connects supplier inventory with travel sellers and provides reservation, retailing and payment tools to travel companies; service provider: Integrates reservation, pricing and booking systems for airlines and travel sellers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: Travel distribution, airline software and travel payments

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise sales teams serving airlines, travel agencies and other travel suppliers; online: Agency booking tools and APIs that connect online travel sellers to supplier inventory; partners / resellers: Regional distribution partners and travel technology integrators

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Traveler data is subject to privacy laws such as GDPR, payment card handling is subject to PCI DSS.
